batch_node.name: GitLab dimensions v0.1.0
batch_node.description: Dimension nodes for every dimension key the gitlab plugin declares, so each key has a declared node before the dimension map moves to keying by node id (tap#708, tap#711).

node.name: gitlab.plane
node.description: Which plane of a GitLab deployment a node or edge belongs to: infrastructure (the processes a deployment runs and what they run on and store to) or application (the objects GitLab keeps in its own database). See the dimension table in specs/spec-gitlab-v0.md.
